# Catalog Pre-Construction Run Ownership

Binding: broad #2151/#2542 approval, the existing catalog pre-construction
ordering contract, selected fixture/lifecycle ownership in platform-spec.yaml,
and the unchanged canonical RunFixture / MaterializeRun operation.

Chosen cohort: scenario admission in the shared catalog runtime constructor,
including all additional run IDs. The existing native selected run and source
artifact owners replace both dialect-specific raw lifecycle helpers. Origin,
run ID, exact admitted artifact/hash, author/source/process context and the
pre-NewRuntime cut remain unchanged. This is not a production runtime semantic
change and introduces no new persistence owner, framework or compatibility.

The two backend dependency assemblers, other catalog raw read/fault sites and
generic handle-returning fixtures remain explicit #2542 debt. This family does
not claim to close the whole catalog/runtime construction class.

## Systematic Consumption

| Consumer | Disposition and exact proof |
| --- | --- |
| Shared constructor, both dialects and every additionalRunIDs entry | Moved to the existing selected lifecycle/source owner; one finite recipe preserves every other constructor, startup, receipt, handler, observation and cleanup statement. |
| New runtime and transcript-based startup callers | Same corrected constructor; focused real publication/reply roots execute both stores, not only structural matching. |
| Reopened transcript runtime | Existing no-reseed reopen path unchanged; real evidence append/replay root retains exact no-duplicate and subsequent new-event assertions on both stores. |
| Raw source/context/backend substitution or dropped setup | Invalid; hostile codemod controls require the original scenario origin, artifact/hash, run, selected store and per-run context. |
| Scenario admission after runtime construction | Invalid; existing source guard pins the sole shared constructor call before NewRuntime and refuses raw lifecycle imports. |
| Causal-order readback fixture without any runtime construction | Different semantic concept: persisted readback witness, not boot admission. Its native RequireRun remains lawful; the unchanged causal-chain assertion root is named proof. No filename/function waiver is added. |
| Remaining catalog fixture families | Still tracked by the exact decreasing ledger; no new permission or disappearance claim. |
